security.openAccount: Set it up in your account

support.title: Support access
support.intro: If you need help, let platform support look into your organization for a few days: team, weddings and the audit log, read-only. Every look is recorded in your audit log.
support.reasonPlaceholder: e.g. a team member cannot sign in

audit.membership.updated: changed a team member's role or status
audit.project_member.added: assigned a team member to a wedding
audit.project_member.removed: removed a team member from a wedding
audit.project_vendor.added: added a vendor to a wedding
audit.project_vendor.removed: removed a vendor from a wedding
audit.task.shared_with_client: shared a task with the couple
audit.couple.invited: invited the couple to the portal
audit.document.shared_with_client: shared a document with the couple
audit.document.virus_found: blocked a file that contained a virus
audit.event.shared_with_client: shared an appointment with the couple
audit.calendar_feed.revoked: turned off a calendar subscription link
audit.privacy.client_erased: erased a client and their weddings
audit.support_access.granted: allowed platform support to look in
audit.admin.two_factor_reset: (platform admin) reset a member's two-factor authentication

weddings.title: Weddings
weddings.newSubtitle: Tasks and milestones are created from your template and scheduled backwards from the wedding date.
weddings.emptyBody: Create your first wedding to start planning.

fields.title: Title
fields.titleHint: Optional. Defaults to the couple's name.
fields.templateHint: Milestones and tasks to start with.

weddings.confirmDelete: Delete “{{title}}”? It moves to the trash for 30 days.
weddings.internalOnly: Internal – never shown to the couple

clients.title: Clients
clients.subtitle: Couples and enquiries, from first contact to the wedding.
clients.emptyBody: Add an enquiry or create a wedding to get started.

vendors.title: Vendors
vendors.subtitle: Your trusted photographers, florists, caterers and more.
vendors.emptyBody: Build your directory once and reuse it for every wedding.

templates.title: Templates
templates.subtitle: Reusable plans: milestones and tasks scheduled relative to the wedding date.
templates.confirmDelete: Delete the template “{{name}}”? Existing weddings keep their tasks.
templates.explainer: When a wedding is created from this template, each item's due date is calculated from the wedding date.

tasks.visibilityHint: New tasks are internal. Share a task to show it to the couple in their portal.
tasks.mySubtitle: Everything assigned to you, across all your weddings.
tasks.myEmptyBody: Tasks assigned to you in any wedding appear here.

warnings.over_budget: The forecast is {{amount}} above the total budget.
warnings.near_budget: Only {{amount}} left before the total budget is reached.

budget.footnote: Internal costs, internal notes and items marked internal are never shown to the couple. Every change to an amount is recorded in the audit log.
budget.visibilityHint: Visible items appear in the couple's budget, without internal cost and notes.

couple.title: Client portal
couple.hint: Invite the couple to follow their planning, tick off their tasks and see shared budget items.
couple.sent: Invitation sent. The link is valid for 7 days.

documents.fileHint: PDF, Word, Excel, PowerPoint, text or images, up to {{max}} MB.
documents.tooLarge: This file is larger than {{max}} MB.
documents.titleHint: Optional. The file name is used if you leave it empty.
documents.shareHint: The couple can see and download it in their portal.
documents.confirmDelete: Delete this document and all its versions for good?
documents.emptyBody: Keep contracts, quotes, invoices and inspiration for this wedding in one place.
documents.footnote: Uploaded files are checked for viruses before they can be opened. Only this wedding's team, and the couple for shared documents, can download them.

calendar.title: Calendar
calendar.weddingIntro: Appointments for this wedding: tastings, fittings, meetings and more.
calendar.notesHint: Notes stay in the app; they are not included in calendar subscriptions.
calendar.shareHint: The couple sees it in their portal and calendar subscription.
calendar.endBeforeStart: The end time is before the start time.
calendar.emptyBody: Add tastings, fittings and meetings so the whole team knows what is coming up.

feed.title: Subscribe to your calendar
feed.intro: Add your weddings, appointments and your tasks to Apple Calendar, Google Calendar or Outlook. They update automatically.
feed.onceHint: Keep this link to yourself: anyone with it can see your calendar. It is shown only now.
feed.howApple: Apple Calendar: File → New Calendar Subscription, then paste the link.
feed.howGoogle: Google Calendar: Other calendars → + → From URL, then paste the link.
feed.howOutlook: Outlook: Add calendar → Subscribe from web, then paste the link.
feed.active: A subscription link is active since {{date}}.
feed.inactive: You have no subscription link yet.
feed.privacy: For your privacy the subscription contains titles, times and places only – no notes or amounts.

notifications.title: Notifications
notifications.intro: Choose which emails you get from {{organization}}. Emails tell you what happened and link to it; they never contain comment text or amounts.
notifications.coupleIntro: Choose which emails you get about your wedding.
notifications.privacy: Important account emails, like invitations and password resets, are always sent.

task_assigned.title: Tasks assigned to me
task_assigned.team: When someone gives you a task.
task_assigned.couple: When your planner gives you a task.

comments.title: Comments
comments.team: New comments on your tasks, and messages from couples on weddings you lead.
comments.couple: Replies from your planner on your tasks.

documents.title: Documents
documents.team: When a couple uploads a document on a wedding you lead.
documents.couple: When your planner shares a document with you.

daily_digest.title: Daily overview
daily_digest.team: Each morning: today's and tomorrow's appointments, your tasks due and anything overdue.
daily_digest.couple: A short morning email when appointments or tasks for you are coming up.

account.title: Account
account.passwordChanged: Password changed. Other devices were signed out.

twoFactor.title: Two-factor authentication
twoFactor.intro: Protect your account with a code from an authenticator app (for example Google Authenticator, 1Password or Microsoft Authenticator) in addition to your password.
twoFactor.requiredByOrganization: Your organization requires two-factor authentication. Turn it on to continue.
twoFactor.turnOffBody: Your account will only be protected by your password. Confirm with your password and a current code.
twoFactor.step1: Open your authenticator app and add a new account.
twoFactor.step2: Scan the QR code, or enter the key by hand.
twoFactor.step3: Enter the 6-digit code the app shows.
twoFactor.qrAlt: QR code for your authenticator app
twoFactor.codesIntro: Save these recovery codes somewhere safe. Each one works once if you lose your phone. They are shown only now.
twoFactor.codesFileHeader: Recovery codes for the Wedding Planning Platform. Each code works once.

data.title: Your data
data.exportBody: Download a copy of the personal data stored about you: your profile, memberships, sign-ins, settings, comments and activity.
data.deleteBody: Deleting your account removes you from all organizations. Weddings and documents belong to your organization and stay there.
data.deleteBodyCouple: Deleting your account ends your portal access. Your planner keeps the wedding details they need; ask them if you want those erased too.
data.deleteWarning: This cannot be undone. Your login is removed and your name is replaced with “Deleted user” wherever it appears.

privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.portalIntro: Some things {{organization}} may only do with your permission. You can change your answer at any time.
privacy.portalFootnote: To download your data or delete your account, open your

client.title: Data protection
client.intro: Export everything stored about this client (for a data access request), or erase it for good.
client.eraseWarning: This deletes the client, all their weddings with tasks, budget, appointments and documents, and the couple's portal access. It cannot be undone. Export the data first if you need a copy.

consents.title: Couple's permissions
consents.plannerHint: Decided by the couple in their portal.

portfolio.title: Show our wedding as a reference
portfolio.body: {{organization}} may show photos and details of our wedding on their website and social media.

reviews.title: Ask us for a review
reviews.body: {{organization}} may email us after the wedding to ask for a review.

admin.title: Platform admin
admin.intro: Names and numbers only. To look into an organization, one of its admins grants support access.
admin.needs2fa: Platform admins must use two-factor authentication.
admin.confirmSuspend: Suspend {{name}}? Nobody in it can sign in to it until it is reactivated.

create.name: Organization name
create.hint: They receive an invitation by email.
create.done: {{name}} was created and the invitation sent.

reset2fa.intro: For someone who lost their phone and recovery codes. Needs support access from their organization and is recorded there.
reset2fa.done: Done. They can sign in with their password and set it up again.
